v1.0.64 — Sidecar cold-start budget extension. No Python changes; this release widens the Tauri shell's patience for a slow sidecar startup so post-PC-restart launches don't time out and respawn into a zombie sidecar.

### Fixes

- **"Still starting · poll #39" hang after a PC restart.** The Tauri shell polled `/api/status` with 5 retries and exponential backoff capped at 16s (≈70s total budget). Post-PC-restart, the frozen Python interpreter + Sentry/MT5/Telethon/Flask module imports + cold-disk `init_db` + 28 SQLite migrations could exceed that budget, so Tauri's `stop_sidecar()` fired before Flask bound port 5000. `TerminateProcess` on a Python interpreter stuck in a C-extension DLL load (MT5, Telethon) doesn't always reap the process, so the original sidecar lingered as a zombie while the respawned one raced for port 5000. Bumping `MAX_RETRIES` to 10 and capping backoff at 8s gives the sidecar ≈120s of cold-start budget — comfortably covering observed cold-start times. Retries reset on the first successful poll, so warm-start behaviour is unchanged.
